skills.name: pr-description-writer
skills.description: This skill generates and improves GitHub pull request descriptions that help reviewers understand context and promote effective code reviews. Use this skill when creating new PRs, updating PR descriptions with new commits, or reviewing existing PR descriptions for quality. The skill analyzes git commits to extract key changes and generates descriptions with proper context (why), implementation details (how), file prioritization for large PRs, and testing strategy.
